findings.label: Ring tap drops userId
findings.description: avatarOnPress in ChatItem calls router.push('/stories') and router.push('/moments') without a ?userId= query param. handleNotifNavigation in HeaderPanels.tsx already passes ?userId= correctly. Tapping the avatar ring drops the user on the generic feed instead of the specific contact's content. Fix: pass other.user_id as a query param in all three branches.

findings.label: TSC artifact missing
findings.description: avatar-ring-nav-tsc.txt was never written by any prior step. TypeScript correctness was assessed by source reading. Errors that only manifest under full module resolution (route type narrowing, exhaustiveness under `as any` casts) cannot be ruled out without a compiler run.
